title: nephrodium biforme
intro: Nephrodium biforme, commonly known as Maidenhair Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium biforme include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural remedy for various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
